_comment: Knowledge cards attached to catalog records by load_catalog and returned by get_record. Written 2026-10-24 by Sebastian with Claude Code from local files, catalog records and the cited sources; review_status pending. Local hashes are copied from each PROVENANCE.json.

rad-dino.task_modality_anatomy: feature_extraction; X-ray; pretrained on chest radiographs only, used here on bone radiographs as a transfer experiment
rad-dino.input: 3 channels (grayscale replicated), 518 x 518, mean 0.5307 / std 0.2583 per preprocessor_config.json. The workbench default 'pad' pads the whole radiograph to a square; 'native_crop' reproduces the publisher's shortest-edge resize and center crop.
rad-dino.official_processor: preprocessor_config.json (transformers BitImageProcessor), parsed and checked against the code's constants on every load
rad-dino.native_output: 768-dim CLS token after the final layer norm (pooler_output). A feature vector: no labels, probabilities or findings.
rad-dino.adapter_status: installed as frozen-encoder:rad-dino when the ml extra is importable; reachable through run_specialist (catalog: locally_reproduced, inference allowed for research use)
evidence: Weights match the publisher checksum; loads with no missing or unexpected keys (docs/reports/E-model-runtime-check.md)
native_crop matches the publisher processor on 16 real JPEGs to within two gray levels, embedding cosine >= 0.99999 (same report)
Exploratory image-level BTXRD linear probe only (docs/reports/E-btxrd-exploratory-baseline.md); not medical performance
rad-dino.training_overlap: Five public chest X-ray sets per the model card (MIMIC-CXR, CheXpert, NIH-CXR, PadChest, BRAX; 882,775 images). No bone set listed. training_images.csv not downloaded, so overlap with BTXRD is unlikely but not checked.

terms.inference: allowed for research use: model card says 'shared for research purposes only' and 'not meant to be used for clinical practice'; LICENSE is MIT (Microsoft)
terms.adaptation: unreviewed (MIT permits modification; research-only statement still applies)
terms.redistribution: unreviewed: do not share weights or derived heads

unknowns: Whether chest pretraining transfers to bone tumors
Overlap with BTXRD sources (training_images.csv not checked)

resnet50-a1-in1k.task_modality_anatomy: feature_extraction; natural-image pretraining, used on X-rays as the non-medical arm of a matched comparison
resnet50-a1-in1k.input: 3 channels, 288 x 288 (timm test_input_size; train size 224), ImageNet mean/std, bicubic. Workbench default 'pad' keeps the whole radiograph; 'native_crop' matches timm's transform exactly.
resnet50-a1-in1k.official_processor: pretrained_cfg in config.json (timm), parsed and checked on every load
resnet50-a1-in1k.native_output: 2048-dim global average pool before the classifier (fc dropped on purpose). A feature vector, not ImageNet class scores and not a medical prediction.
resnet50-a1-in1k.adapter_status: installed as frozen-encoder:resnet50-a1-in1k when the ml extra is importable; reachable through run_specialist (catalog: locally_reproduced, inference allowed for research use)
evidence: Weights match the publisher checksum; strict load apart from the dropped fc layer (docs/reports/E-model-runtime-check.md)
native_crop matches timm exactly on 16 real JPEGs (cosine 1.0)
Specialist-path embedding for btxrd:IMG000001 equals the stored pad-variant feature cache bit for bit (2026-10-24)
resnet50-a1-in1k.training_overlap: ImageNet-1k natural images; no medical images expected.

terms.inference: allowed for research use: model card license Apache-2.0
terms.adaptation: unreviewed (Apache-2.0 permits it; ImageNet-1k's own non-commercial research terms may matter for derived weights)

unknowns: Whether ImageNet terms reach the weights or derived heads

monai-lung-nodule-ct-detection.input: 1 channel CT patches, spatial shape multiples of 16 x 16 x 8, float16 in [0, 1] after the bundle's resampling and intensity windowing (configs/metadata.json, configs/inference.json)
monai-lung-nodule-ct-detection.native_output: Per-volume dict of 3D boxes, the single label 'nodule' and detection-confidence scores. Says where nodule candidates are, not whether they are malignant.
monai-lung-nodule-ct-detection.adapter_status: no adapter; catalog_only (evidence cataloged, inference unreviewed). run_specialist returns a rejection.
evidence: Files hash-verified against the publisher at download; never loaded or run here
monai-lung-nodule-ct-detection.training_overlap: Trained on LUNA16, which is derived from LIDC-IDRI, so lidc-idri-sample and nodulemnist3d are not independent test data for it.

terms.inference: unreviewed (bundle Apache-2.0; LUNA16 CC BY 4.0, LIDC-IDRI CC BY 3.0)

unknowns: models/model.pt is a pickle: load only model.ts or with weights_only=True
Behaviour on CT outside LUNA16's acquisition range

monai-brats-mri-segmentation.input: 4 co-registered channels in order T1c, T1, T2, FLAIR; spatial shape multiples of 8 (configs/metadata.json)
monai-brats-mri-segmentation.native_output: 3-channel mask in [0, 1]: tumor core, whole tumor, enhancing tumor. Outlines regions; not a histologic diagnosis or grade.
monai-brats-mri-segmentation.adapter_status: no adapter; catalog_only. run_specialist returns a rejection.
evidence: Files hash-verified against the publisher at download; never loaded or run here
monai-brats-mri-segmentation.training_overlap: BraTS 2018 with the bundle authors' own split; msd-brain-tumour overlaps BraTS and cannot serve as independent evaluation.

terms.inference: unreviewed (bundle Apache-2.0; BraTS use requires citing the BraTS manuscripts)

unknowns: Needs all four sequences co-registered; a single sequence is not a valid input

medsiglip-448.task_modality_anatomy: feature_extraction / zero_shot_classification; several medical modalities per the publisher
medsiglip-448.input: 448 x 448 per the publisher; exact processor not inspected here
medsiglip-448.official_processor: preprocessor_config.json in the gated repository (not acquired)
medsiglip-448.native_output: Embeddings and image-text similarities. Neither is a validated bone-tumor classifier.
medsiglip-448.adapter_status: not acquired; no adapter. Gated: HAI-DEF terms must be accepted by a named person first.
evidence: Publisher documentation only, as summarized in the Team Hub T02 tab; nothing run here
medsiglip-448.training_overlap: Not reviewed. Check against BTXRD's Radiopaedia and MedPix sources before any evaluation.

terms.inference: unreviewed: Health AI Developer Foundations terms (https://developers.google.com/health-ai-developer-foundations/terms)
terms.adaptation: unreviewed (HAI-DEF has its own derivative provisions)
terms.redistribution: unreviewed (HAI-DEF has distribution and hosted-service provisions)

unknowns: Who on the team accepts the HAI-DEF terms

btxrd.release: figshare doi:10.6084/m9.figshare.27865398.v1, CC BY 4.0; paper Yao et al., Scientific Data 12, 88 (2025), doi:10.1038/s41597-024-04311-y
btxrd.units: 3,746 radiograph images (3,719 .jpeg + 27 .jpg) and 1,867 LabelMe annotation files. Patients and lesions: unknown, because dataset.xlsx has no patient, case or lesion column and the paper says several views can show the same lesion.
btxrd.labels: Image-level normal 1,879 / benign 1,525 / malignant 342 from clean flag triples; tumor boxes and polygons; subtype, site, center, age, gender, view.
btxrd.reference_standard: Histology or two radiology experts per the paper; which applies to each row is not recorded.
btxrd.grouping: None in the release. The workbench refuses to infer patients from filenames, order, age/gender or center (Hub D04).
btxrd.duplicates_and_overlap: 21 byte-identical pairs (2 with conflicting benign/normal labels, all 4 images unlabeled). Feature-similarity search found more near duplicates and likely same-patient pairs, many crossing an image-stratified split. Center 1 is three hospitals; centers 2 and 3 are Radiopaedia and MedPix, already examined as test data.
btxrd.privacy: Some source JPEGs keep EXIF GPS, author and date tags; review before sharing derivatives.
btxrd.can_teach: Exploratory image-level classification, source-shift sensitivity, box/polygon handling and why missing patient IDs block patient-independent claims.

data_products.medical_images_labels: images, flags and annotations under CC BY 4.0 (attribution and change notices required)
data_products.tool_workflows: audit, manifest, baseline, source-shift and near-duplicate commands in this repository
data_products.teacher_outputs: None. No teacher outputs exist or are permitted for this record yet.

unknowns: overlap with other public bone X-ray sets

cbis-ddsm.release: TCIA collection CBIS-DDSM, doi:10.7937/K9/TCIA.2016.7O02S9CY, CC BY 3.0; Lee et al. 2017
cbis-ddsm.units: 1,566 participants carrying 6,671 TCIA patient IDs (several per participant), 6,775 DICOM series, 3,568 abnormality rows. 163 GB in total, so only patient subsets fit the 40 GB budget; nothing is in data/ yet.
cbis-ddsm.labels: Lesion-level pathology MALIGNANT / BENIGN / BENIGN_WITHOUT_CALLBACK, BI-RADS assessment, density and subtlety in four case-description CSVs (calc/mass x train/test).
cbis-ddsm.reference_standard: Pathology column per row; how each row was confirmed is not reviewed.
cbis-ddsm.grouping: Verified: P_xxxxx participant IDs group all of a participant's patient IDs.
cbis-ddsm.duplicates_and_overlap: The official split was made separately for mass and calcification cases, so 31 participants appear in both a train and a test file; a patient-level split must regroup them.
compatible_models: None cataloged for mammography: the router rejects rad-dino and resnet50-a1-in1k for modality 'mammography'
cbis-ddsm.can_teach: Patient-grouped splitting when real IDs exist, lesion versus image units, and auditing an official split for leakage.
cbis-ddsm.cannot_teach: Anything about bone tumors; screening performance without a reviewed protocol.

data_products.medical_images_labels: DICOM images, crops and masks plus CSV labels under CC BY 3.0
data_products.tool_workflows: subset fetch by participant (fetch plan|get cbis-ddsm --sample N)
data_products.teacher_outputs: None. No teacher outputs exist or are permitted for this record yet.

lidc-idri-sample.release: TCIA collection LIDC-IDRI, doi:10.7937/K9/TCIA.2015.LO9QL9SX, CC BY 3.0; Armato et al. 2011
lidc-idri-sample.units: 3 patients, 3 CT series, 406 DICOM images here (collection: 1,010 patients, 1,018 CT series). Files recorded trust-on-first-use (no publisher checksum).
lidc-idri-sample.labels: None here: radiologist XML annotations are distributed separately and were not fetched.
lidc-idri-sample.reference_standard: Not applicable without the XML reads; LIDC reads are radiologist annotations, not pathology.
lidc-idri-sample.duplicates_and_overlap: LIDC-IDRI is the source of LUNA16, the MONAI lung detector's training data, and of NoduleMNIST3D.
lidc-idri-sample.can_teach: DICOM ingestion and a detector adapter smoke test.
lidc-idri-sample.cannot_teach: Detector evaluation: the detector was trained on this collection.

data_products.teacher_outputs: None. No teacher outputs exist or are permitted for this record yet.

breastmnist.release: MedMNIST v2 (Yang et al., Scientific Data 2023), Zenodo doi:10.5281/zenodo.10519652, CC BY 4.0; source breast ultrasound set from Al-Dhabyani et al. 2020
breastmnist.units: 780 grayscale ultrasound images at 28 x 28 (and 224 x 224): train 546, val 78, test 156, measured from the local npz. Patients: unknown.
breastmnist.labels: Binary. Local label counts (index 0 / 1): train 147/399, val 21/57, test 42/114. MedMNIST documents 0 = malignant, 1 = normal or benign (not re-checked against the source here).
breastmnist.reference_standard: Inherited from the source dataset; not reviewed.
breastmnist.grouping: None; MedMNIST splits may not respect source patients.
compatible_models: Router: rad-dino rejects modality 'ultrasound'; resnet50-a1-in1k accepts it as a generic encoder
breastmnist.can_teach: Fast pipeline and loader tests on small arrays.
breastmnist.cannot_teach: Medical performance: tiny downsampled images with unknown patient grouping.

data_products.teacher_outputs: None. No teacher outputs exist or are permitted for this record yet.

unknowns: label index meaning not re-checked locally

nodulemnist3d.release: MedMNIST v2, Zenodo doi:10.5281/zenodo.10519652, CC BY 4.0 (source LIDC-IDRI, CC BY 3.0)
nodulemnist3d.units: 1,633 nodule volumes at 28^3 (and 64^3): train 1,158, val 165, test 310, measured from the local npz. Patients: not in the release.
nodulemnist3d.labels: Binary benign/malignant. Local counts (index 0 / 1): train 863/295, val 123/42, test 246/64.
nodulemnist3d.reference_standard: Radiologist malignancy suspicion ratings, not confirmed diagnosis.
nodulemnist3d.grouping: No patient IDs; several nodules can come from one patient.
nodulemnist3d.duplicates_and_overlap: Derived from LIDC-IDRI, the MONAI lung detector's training source.
nodulemnist3d.can_teach: 3D array handling and why a rating-derived label is not a pathology label.
